# Surfbird

> Unofficial self-hosted Docker distribution of Cloudflare Kitesurf — a
> headless browser engine built for AI agents. One container gives you CDP
> (Puppeteer/Playwright-compatible), optional token auth, and a REST action
> layer: markdown extraction, screenshots, PDFs, HTML content, JS evaluation,
> and batch fetching. Not affiliated with Cloudflare.

## Images

- `terry2010/surfbird:raw` — engine only, container port 8787. CDP +
  `/json/*` + `/rbi/*` routes. No auth — bind loopback only.
- `terry2010/surfbird:auth` — engine + token proxy, container port 8080.
  REST actions live here. `Authorization: Bearer $SURFBIRD_TOKEN`.
- `terry2010/surfbird:raw-<tag>` / `:auth-<tag>` — pinned to upstream kitesurf
  tag (e.g. `auth-2026.11.9`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird#readme): quick start, image
  table, env vars, security notes
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird/blob/main/skills/surfbird/SKILL.md):
  agent-facing REST usage guide (mount as an agent skill)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  repo guide for coding agents
- OpenAPI: `GET /openapi.json` on the auth image — machine-readable spec
  for every REST route

## Clients

- [JS SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/surfbird): `npm i surfbird` —
  `new Surfbird(url, {token})` → `.markdown(url) .content(url) .source(url)
  .screenshot(url) .pdf(url) .evaluate(url,script) .batch(action,urls,opts)`
- [MCP server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/surfbird-mcp):
  `npx surfbird-mcp` — stdio tools `surf_markdown surf_content surf_source
  surf_screenshot surf_pdf surf_evaluate surf_batch`
- [Python client](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird/blob/main/examples/python/surfbird.py):
  stdlib-only, same method surface
- [Bash examples](https://github.com/terry2010/surfbird/tree/main/examples/bash):
  curl one-liners per endpoint
- [dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf](https://github.com/terry2010/dsh-control-surfbird-for-kitesurf):
  DSH plugin for interactive CDP control (`surfbird_*` tools) — OpenCode/Pi
  versions in progress

## REST API (auth image only)

- `POST /markdown` `{url,timeout?}` — article → markdown (Readability+Turndown)
- `POST /content` `{url,timeout?}` — rendered DOM (post-JS)
- `POST /source` `{url,timeout?}` — original response body ("view source", pre-JS)
- `POST /screenshot` `{url,timeout?,width?,height?,fullPage?}` — PNG (base64)
- `POST /pdf` `{url,timeout?,landscape?}` — PDF (base64)
- `POST /evaluate` `{url,script,timeout?}` — run JS in page, return result
- `POST /batch` `{action,urls[],script?,timeout?}` — up to MAX_BATCH_URLS
- `GET /health` — liveness + `cdpEndpoint` (no auth). `GET /openapi.json` — spec.
- Errors: 401 unauthorized, 400 invalid_input, 403 url_blocked,
  413 payload_too_large, 429 busy, 504 action_timeout, 502 bad_gateway

## CDP (interactive control — both images)

REST actions are one-shot (fresh page per call). For persistent tabs,
click/type, screenshots and console/network inspection, speak CDP
directly over WebSocket:

- Endpoint: `ws(s)://<host>/devtools/browser` — raw image `:8787` direct,
  auth image `:8080` via proxy with `Authorization: Bearer $SURFBIRD_TOKEN`
  on the upgrade. `GET /health` returns `cdpEndpoint` for discovery.
- One WebSocket = one isolated browser; `Target.*` manages tabs inside it.
  Closing the socket destroys all tabs — no cross-connection state.
- Session caps: ~10 min idle disconnect (any CDP message resets), 60 min
  hard limit per connection.
- Engine limits (upstream): no JS dialogs, file upload/download, clipboard,
  touch/drag; Boa not V8; partial hit-testing.

## Env vars

- `SURFBIRD_MODE` `raw|auth` (default raw) · `SURFBIRD_TOKEN` required in auth
- `SURFBIRD_PORT` 8080 · `ENGINE_PORT` 8787 · `ENGINE_HOST` 127.0.0.1
- `REST_TIMEOUT_MS` 120000 · `MAX_CONCURRENT_ACTIONS` 2 · `MAX_BATCH_URLS` 20
- `MAX_BODY_BYTES` 4MiB · `SURFBIRD_URL_ALLOWLIST` / `SURFBIRD_URL_BLOCKLIST`
  regex URL gates · `TLS_CERT_PATH`/`TLS_KEY_PATH` HTTPS ·
  `SURFBIRD_INSPECTOR=1` exposes worker inspector :9229
